name: Mount Bonnell
description: Limestone overlook above Lake Austin with one of the best views in the city.
why: One of the best views in the city.

name: Capital Factory
description: Downtown coworking hub at the center of Austin's startup scene.
why: The center of Austin's startup scene.

name: Hi, How Are You Mural
description: Daniel Johnston's wide-eyed frog from his 1983 album cover, painted on a wall at 21st and Guadalupe.
why: Daniel Johnston's wide-eyed frog, up close.

name: Barton Springs Pool
description: Spring-fed pool that stays around 68°F all year, three acres of cold, clear water in the middle of Zilker Park.
why: Cold, clear spring water at 68°F all year.

name: Hartman Prehistoric Garden
description: A corner of Zilker Botanical Garden built around dinosaur tracks found on the site, planted with species from the age of dinosaurs.
why: Dinosaur tracks found right on the site.

name: Zilker Hillside Theater
description: Grassy hillside stage that hosts free musicals under the stars every summer.
why: Free musicals under the stars every summer.

name: Lou Neff Point
description: Quiet bend in the Lady Bird Lake trail where Barton Creek meets the river, with the skyline across the water.
why: A quiet bend with the skyline across the water.

name: Austin Nature & Science Center
description: Free nature center with rescued wildlife and a dino pit where kids and grown-ups dig for fossil casts.
why: Rescued wildlife and a dino pit to dig in.

name: Zilker Moonlight Tower
description: One of Austin's 1890s moonlight towers, strung with lights every December to become the Zilker Holiday Tree.
why: An 1890s tower that becomes the holiday tree.

name: Deep Eddy Pool
description: The oldest swimming pool in Texas, fed by cool well water, right off the Lady Bird Lake trail.
why: The oldest swimming pool in Texas.

name: Sculpture Falls
description: Limestone ledges and swimming pools along the Barton Creek Greenbelt. Best after rain; can run dry in drought.
why: Limestone ledges and swimming holes after rain.

name: Twin Falls
description: A pair of small cascades a short hike from the MoPac greenbelt entrance. Flows after rain.
why: Two small cascades, a short hike in.

name: Bull Creek District Park
description: Shady creek park with shallow limestone pools and a small waterfall to wade under.
why: Wade under a small waterfall in shady pools.

name: Greetings from Austin Mural
description: Postcard-style mural on South First Street, the city's most photographed wall.
why: The city's most photographed wall.

name: Treaty Oak
description: A centuries-old live oak in a pocket park west of downtown, nursed back to health after it was poisoned in 1989.
why: A centuries-old oak that survived a poisoning.

name: Congress Avenue Bridge Bats
description: Up to 1.5 million Mexican free-tailed bats pour out from under the bridge at dusk, spring through fall.
why: Up to 1.5 million bats pour out at dusk.

name: Pennybacker Bridge Overlook
description: Rocky hilltop above Loop 360 looking down on the bridge and Lake Austin. Short, steep walk up from the road.
why: A short, steep climb to the bridge view.

name: Umlauf Sculpture Garden
description: Shaded garden of Charles Umlauf's bronze and stone sculptures beside Zilker Park.
why: Bronze and stone sculptures in a shady garden.

name: Texas State Capitol
description: Pink granite capitol that stands taller than the U.S. Capitol, with free tours most days.
why: Taller than the U.S. Capitol, with free tours.

name: McKinney Falls
description: State park inside the city limits where Onion Creek spills over wide limestone ledges.
why: Creek falls over limestone, inside city limits.

name: Enchanted Rock
description: Giant pink granite dome in the Hill Country. The summit view is worth the climb.
why: A giant pink granite dome worth the climb.

name: Old Faithful
description: Yellowstone's most famous geyser, erupting about every 90 minutes in the Upper Geyser Basin.
why: Erupts about every 90 minutes.

name: Grand Canyon: Mather Point
description: The classic first look into the Grand Canyon from the South Rim.
why: The classic first look into the Grand Canyon.

name: Statue of Liberty
description: Lady Liberty on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.
why: Lady Liberty in New York Harbor.

name: Yosemite: Tunnel View
description: Yosemite Valley in one frame: El Capitan, Bridalveil Fall, and Half Dome.
why: Yosemite Valley's icons in one frame.
